About

From intelligence analysis to cloud architecture.

I'm a multi-disciplined corporate and intelligence-community professional transitioning into cloud computing. Over ten-plus years I've led teams, run research, and made decisions under pressure — in national security, cyber-crime investigation, and business intelligence. For the past year-plus, I've put that same rigor into the AWS ecosystem, upskilling daily and shipping hands-on projects.

My background spans data analytics, data visualization, AI/ML, international affairs, and threat and risk assessment — disciplines that all come down to the same core skill cloud architecture rewards: reading a complex system clearly enough to make it more secure, more reliable, and easier for the next person to understand.
